subject: english
stem: Across a paragraph, 'the lake,' 'its water,' 'the shore,' and 'the area' appear. Which claim is safest?
options: They can support one lake topic while naming different parts
Every phrase names exactly the water
The paragraph must have four topics
shore means the same thing as water

optionRationales.reason: They can support one lake topic while naming different parts：不同部分可共同支持 lake 主題，但不必字義完全相同。
Every phrase names exactly the water：shore 與 area 不等於 water。
The paragraph must have four topics：部分名稱不必各自成為主題。
shore means the same thing as water：shore 是岸邊，不能當 water 同義詞。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「重複詞、同義改寫與上位概念形成的詞鏈」可推出 They can support one lake topic while naming different parts；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 They can support one lake topic while naming different parts 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
